args.summary: Played about 49 steps as a newcomer. I ended many turns and opened most panels. I never found save/load in Settings. I never met other peoples, so I saw no diplomacy, battles, or ships. The Peoples tab shows "0 met" with little guidance on what to do next. The map is small and fogged, and the Chronicle panel is cramped on a phone. Pacing felt slow: I ended turns with little to do. The game is okay but I got lost.
